item.title: Laser pointed at North Bay police officer causes temporarily blindness
item.description: The North Bay Police Service has arrested a 36-year-old North Bay man following an incident on Feb. 22 in which a laser pointer was directed at a police cruiser, briefly blinding the officer driving. Two officers were on general patrol in the Lakeshore Drive area when the driver of the cruiser was temporarily blinded by the laser, […]

item.description: Roughly 90 per cent of Canadian exports to the U.S. continue to flow tariff-free under exemptions within the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement
